adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, attendees are persisted to the DB via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)` before calling `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` (around line ~165). That call is not wrapped in a `try/catch`. If `updateCalendarAttendees` throws, the mutation will error back to the client after the DB change has already been committed, and the subsequent email send block will be skipped (it only wraps `sendAddGuestsEmails`, which is after the calendar update). This creates a partial-success/inconsistent state exactly as the finding describes.
